# teams agent blueprint update

Update an Agent 365 agent blueprint (messaging endpoint)

## Usage

```
teams agent blueprint update [blueprintId] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `blueprintId` | [OPTIONAL] Agent blueprint ID to update. Overrides agent.generated.config.json when given; required if no local config exists. | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--endpoint <url>` | HTTPS URL for the messaging endpoint |
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
